## 改了什么 / What changed


## 怎么测的 / How was it tested
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npx tsc -b` 与 / and `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] 相关浏览器测试 / relevant e2e (`tests/e2e/…`)
- [ ] 新增界面文字已补英文 / new UI text has English (`node scripts/i18n/extract.mjs`)

## 检查 / Checklist
- [ ] 没有真实姓名、联系方式、简历或 API Key / no real personal data or API keys
- [ ] 数据库只做增量迁移 / database changes are additive migrations only
